description: A shell script used for downloading, extracting, installing, and managing application packages, including version handling, signature verification, and post-installation procedures.

methods.name: downloadApp
methods.description: Downloads an application package using specified download location.

methods.name: extractApp
methods.description: Extracts the downloaded application package and its metadata.

methods.name: installApp
methods.description: Installs the application by extracting package contents into the designated directory, fetching metadata, and preparing the environment.

methods.name: verifyAppSignature
methods.description: Verifies the application package signature using an external script.

methods.name: postVerifyInstall
methods.description: Handles post-installation tasks, such as copying metadata and executing install scripts.

methods.name: uninstallApp
methods.description: Removes specified application version directories from the system.

methods.name: updatePkgStatus
methods.description: Updates the package status and broadcasts it.

methods.name: updatePackage
methods.description: Coordinates download, extraction, installation, verification, and post-install processes for a specific package version.
